label: Travellers who have used AI for trip planning or management
question: What is the highest published estimate of AI use in travel planning?
answer: Around 79% of travellers have used AI for trip planning or trip management, per Amadeus research conducted in March 2026.
methodology: Amadeus traveller research conducted March 2026, reported in the airlines agentic AI white paper. The same study found only around 6% comfortable letting AI handle most of their planning.
